title.narrative: EU support for Rehabilitation in Makariv

description.narrative:
Many social objects were damaged during the battle¿s period. Such important for Makariv UTC social infrastructure buildings as kindergartens, schools, medical and municipal institutions also were seriously damaged or destroyed.

This Action¿s proposal is focusing on the refurbishment (of damaged building) or reconstruction (of fully destroyed buildings) of buildings of5majorsocial infrastructure facilities within the area of Makariv Township. The main target is to provide residents of Makariv township and Makariv UTC (both local and IDP) with restored access to this currently destroyed/damaged social/educational/medical infrastructure: Rebuilding of Kindergarten "Barvinok", Rebuilding of Kindergarten "Teremok", Refurbishment of Hospital - Therapeutic block, Refurbishment of Hospital - Polyclinic, Refurbishment of Lyceum #1.
